verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents its own in-product AI features that act on the user's request data: they suggest request names, generate structured payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases. That covers the "suggestions" half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or analysis of the user's data, such as explaining responses or surfacing patterns across collections. The MCP server hands data to external agents, so it is not an in-product AI capability. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of responses and collections, in-depth documentation of the AI features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
